title: Ship regenerates generated files after a clean rebase onto a moved base
body:
Why: PR for t-d93e0n8 (run 43620707280) went red: test/claude/capability-index.test.ts found docs/generated/capability-index.md stale. The branch merged cleanly with main, but main had gained src modules (#856 #857 debf26c) after the branch was cut; rebaseGenerated (src/ci/rebase-generated.ts) returns false on a clean merge-tree and regenerates only on a textual conflict, so ship pushed a stale generated file.
Outcome: when the branch changes a generated file and is not based on origin/<target>, ship rebases onto it, reruns that generator, amends when the output differs, and force-pushes.
Proof: test/ci/rebase-generated.test.ts: a branch whose generated file merges cleanly but is stale against the moved base ends with the regenerated content.
